_help: Put .mp4 files in this folder and list their file names below. Every wall screen is landscape: 'landscape' (16:9, e.g. real club nights) and 'portrait' (9:16, e.g. dancer clips, cropped to fill) both play on the clip screens; 'ads' = sponsor videos. Screens rotate through their list; empty lists show the built-in visualizer / 'your brand here' placeholder. Keep clips short (5-30 s), 720p, muted is fine.
